title: Supervision loop detection treats shell_poll progress polling as struggle
wanted_capability: Mechanical supervision should distinguish repeated progress polling of an existing shell session from repeated tool misuse or no-progress loops, so normal shell_poll cadence does not trigger bro struggling alerts.
missing_primitive: progress-aware tool observation semantics for poll-style tools
fallback_used: Patch supervision.rs to classify known poll-style tool calls as progress observations instead of loop-alert candidates.
notes: Dedupe checked with bbox_gaps for supervision, shell_poll, poll alerts, and loop detection; no existing gaps found.
resolution_note: Addressed in src/orchestration/supervision.rs by marking shell_poll tool observations as non-loop candidates: they remain in recent_hashes/tool_running telemetry but no longer feed loop_hash_max or loop alerts. Regression test added: repeated_shell_poll_events_are_progress_not_loop_alerts.
